basic_details.job_title: MANIT Bhopal Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Professor of Practice, Visiting Professor and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Professor of Practice, Visiting Professor, Adjunct Faculty

important_dates.selection process dates: To be intimated in due course of time

age_limit.details: The official notification does not mention any age limit or age cut-off date.

vacancy_details.details: The institute has invited applications for Professor of Practice, Visiting Professor, and Adjunct Faculty positions across the following 15 academic departments: Architecture and Planning Biological Science and Engineering Chemical Engineering Chemistry Civil Engineering Computer Science and Engineering Electrical Engineering Electronics and Communication Engineering Humanities & Social Sciences Management Studies Materials and Metallurgical Engineering Mathematics, Bioinformatics and Computer Applications Mechanical Engineering Physics Energy Science and Engineering

salary_details.professor of practice: Consolidated emolument upto Rs. 1,75,000/- per month (shall not exceed Last Pay minus Pension in case of reemployment after retirement). Fixed/unchanged during engagement. No DA, increments or other allowances.
salary_details.visiting professor: Maximum monthly ceiling of Rs. 1,50,000/- (shall not exceed Last Pay minus Pension for retired persons). Alternatively, Rs. 3,000/- per period / Rs. 10,000/- per day + TA (as per Institute norms) with a maximum monthly ceiling of Rs. 1,50,000/- (including TA). Fixed/unchanged; no DA or increments.
salary_details.adjunct faculty: Rs. 3,000/- per period / Rs. 10,000/- per day + TA (as per Institute norms), subject to a monthly ceiling of Rs. 1,50,000/- (including TA) per month.
salary_details.details: Further, applicable expenses for attending conferences and seminars incurred as per Institute rules up to Rs. 20,000/- per month shall be considered for reimbursement, subject to an annual ceiling of Rs. 1,00,000/- per year for Professor of Practice and Visiting Professor.

selection_process: The selection process will be intimated by the institute in due course of time.
how_to_apply: Download the application form: Annexure I for the position of 'Professor of Practice' or Annexure II for the position of 'Visiting Professor/Adjunct Faculty' from the official website.
Fill in the application form carefully and sign it.
Enclose self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates, testimonials, research publications (if any), and other supporting documents along with a Curriculum Vitae (CV).
Prepare a statement detailing how your experience will benefit and promote Industry-Institute interaction.
Super-scribe the envelope clearly with the name of the post and department in the format: “Post applied for [name of the post] Department/centre [Name of the department]”.

Send the complete hard copy application through Speed Post or Registered Post to “The Registrar, MANIT Bhopal, Link Road Number 3, Near Kali Mata Mandir, Bhopal (M.P.) – 462003” on or before 02/11/2026.
important_instructions: Persons appointed as PoP, Visiting Professor, or Adjunct Faculty will have no right or claim for regular appointment or continuance of the post. The consolidated remuneration fixed at joining shall remain unchanged throughout the engagement period, and tax deduction will apply as per norms. Candidates employed in Government Departments, Autonomous Bodies, PSUs, Universities, or other educational institutions must submit their applications through proper channel or produce a No Objection Certificate and Vigilance Clearance. The Institute reserves the right not to fill up any or all positions, or select any candidate without assigning any reason. Mere fulfillment of minimum qualifications and experience does not confer any right to selection. The Institute reserves the right to modify, withdraw, or terminate the recruitment process at any stage. Canvassing directly or indirectly will lead to immediate disqualification of the candidature. Unutilized leave (8 days of Casual Leave and 15 days of Special Casual Leave per year) at the end of the year shall lapse and cannot be carried forward.

Ph.D. is desirable but not essential (lack of Ph.D. must be offset by demonstrated domain knowledge obtained from deep experience).
